components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      properties:
        message:

        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

      title: Problem Detail

      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri

          title: Title

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600

          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string

## Summary

I implemented the `locality` field on the owner-creation response. When an owner is created, it is set to `'local'` if their city is the *single* most common city among existing owners at that moment, otherwise `'remote'`.

Changes made, following the codebase's established pattern for derived owner fields (`namesakeCount`, `sharesHousehold`, etc.):

- **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` string property to the `Owner` schema.
- **`model/Owner.java`** — added the `locality` field (`@Column(name = "locality")`) with getter/setter.
- **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — added the `locality VARCHAR(20)` column.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — set `owner.setLocality(localityFor(owner.getCity()))` during `addOwner`, with a helper that:
  - Groups existing owners by city (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized via the existing `normalize`).
  - Finds the max count; if exactly one city holds that max and it matches the new owner's city → `'local'`, else `'remote'`.
  - Returns `'remote'` when there are no existing owners, the city is null, or the top city is a tie.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.java`** — added two tests: a new owner in Madison (the single most common seed city, 4 owners) → `local`; a new owner in Cardiff → `remote`.

Note: I made `locality` a plain string rather than an OpenAPI enum on purpose — MapStruct maps the model String to a generated enum via `Enum.valueOf(...)` by constant *name*, which would fail for lowercase values like `local`/`remote`. A plain string maps cleanly and serializes exactly as the spec requires.
